svg.title: Cloud-OpsBench — six metrics: ours vs the best bare model
svg.desc: 754 cases. On every one of the six metrics, ours (CA 99.9, FA 100.0, JRA 99.9, MC 99.6, EOC 98.0, ECR 98.1) exceeds the best of the ten published bare-model baselines (CA 82.9, FA 75.4, JRA 72.5, MC 70.8, EOC 65.9, ECR 38.2).
